metadata.codeFormat: PSGC codes are 10-character numeric identifiers stored as strings; leading zeroes are significant.
metadata.scopeNote: Counts describe PSA source-level rows, not RECOVPH operations. Special grouping records and Manila SubMun records are reported separately from province, city, municipality, and barangay totals.

regions.name: National Capital Region (NCR)
regions.introduction: NCR has no province-level records in this PSGC release; its cities and Pateros appear directly under the region.
